Name: Talkohlooeys Style Professor Jasper Portrait (with Seasonal Outfit)
Author: Xezcente
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/14216/14216-1666867356-694128039.png[/img]

[size=3][size=3][b][color=#ffff00]Description[/color][/b][/size][/size]
[left]Being a fan of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]Talkohlooeys Portraits [/url]and mods that add NPCs to the world, I wanted HD portraits for characters to match Talkohlooeys' style. I figured I'll try my hand at creating portraits for one of Lemurkat's wonderful NPC mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599?]Professor Jasper Thomas[/url]. I tried my best to capture the style of the original. It's my first time doing art and I hope it doesn't look too out of place with the rest of the characters.

Downloads.Description:
Unzip and place on your mod folder: Stardew Valley/Mods

Set "SeasonalOutfits" in config.json to "True" when using Poltergeister's Seasonal Jasper mod.
